latest.title: Small undecidable groups and unrecognizable 4-manifolds
latest.abstract: We construct a $3$-generator $9$-relator group with unsolvable word problem. We use the group to construct two fixed-size Adian--Rabin families of group presentations, one with $4$ generators and $11$ relators, and another with $2$ generators and $10$ relators. As a consequence, $\#_7(S^2\times S^2)$ is topologically unrecognizable and $\#_9(S^2\times S^2)$ is smoothly unrecognizable. These algebraic and topological results improve the previous best known bounds by Borisov, Tancer, and Gordon. The construction of the group builds upon an example of Borisov and uses additional HNN extensions and Tietze eliminations to reduce the size of the presentation. We also provide a machine-checked Lean~4 formalization of the algebraic results.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 构造 3 生成元9关系的字问题不可解群，并改进固定规模表示族和四维流形不可识别界。
latest.breakthrough: 得到 #₇(S²×S²) 拓扑及 #₉(S²×S²) 光滑不可识别结论。
latest.limitations: 元数据明确主要结果由 ChatGPT 5.6 Sol 开发；形式化声明只覆盖代数结果，不自动覆盖全部拓扑推论。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
